exposure: nutrient intake (carbohydrate, total fat, sucrose, protein, fibre)
cohort: Women with overweight/obesity (n=349) recruited in early pregnancy, including a subgroup diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM, n=98).
finding: Women with GDM more often followed a healthier dietary pattern but had lower adherence to protein, total fat, and fibre recommendations compared to women without GDM, while a good overall dietary quality was associated with better control of glucose metabolism.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy (recruitment in early pregnancy, GDM diagnosis in mid-or-early pregnancy, dietary assessments and blood samples in late pregnancy)
gest_age: Recruitment in early pregnancy, GDM diagnosis at median 14.7 and 25.9 gestational weeks, blood samples in late pregnancy.
